claim: ADR 0259 (founder, 2026-10-02): the type_attributes guard and the two guest-identity guards no longer call rg (absent from the ubuntu-24.04 runner, so each printed PASS over nothing). Each sources scripts/lib/app_code_grep.sh, which searches with git grep and exits 2 when it cannot search; CI runs each guard's --self-test (ci.yml for type_attributes, schema-parity.yml for the guest pair).
verify: ! grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' scripts/check_no_direct_type_attributes_access.sh | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])rg[[:space:]]' && ! grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' scripts/check_no_guest_name_matching.sh | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])rg[[:space:]]' && ! grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' scripts/check_no_raw_guest_channels.sh | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])rg[[:space:]]' && grep -qF 'source "$lib/app_code_grep.sh"' scripts/check_no_direct_type_attributes_access.sh && grep -qF 'source "$lib/app_code_grep.sh"' scripts/check_no_guest_name_matching.sh && grep -qF 'source "$lib/app_code_grep.sh"' scripts/check_no_raw_guest_channels.sh && grep -qF 'exit 2' scripts/lib/app_code_grep.sh && grep -qF 'check_no_direct_type_attributes_access.sh --self-test' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -qF 'check_no_guest_name_matching.sh --self-test' .github/workflows/schema-parity.yml && grep -qF 'check_no_raw_guest_channels.sh --self-test' .github/workflows/schema-parity.yml
